sources.title: A Quantitative Approach to Tactical Asset Allocation
sources.author: Mebane T. Faber

methodology.hypothesis: The ungated four-factor/gold portfolio retains material drawdowns. Compare two fixed trend gates that can remove, but never increase, its equity/gold target budgets; do not retune factor rankings.
methodology.baseline: Reuse the unchanged equal-four-factor/gold63-session monthly inverse-volatility targets with30%-70%equity bounds and2%target idle cash. Each active equity sleeve retains25%in all four existing factor funds.
methodology.equity_indicator: An untraded index compounds the contemporaneous equal-weight daily total returns of the four actual factor funds. It is a signal proxy, not a cost-free account or strategy return.
methodology.joint_indicator: A second untraded index compounds daily returns weighted by the baseline's last known target as of the preceding close. Its cash fraction has zero return. Start only after a complete prior baseline target exists; do not retroactively initialize risk weights or count idle prehistory as observations.
methodology.gate: At every completed close compare the declared index or GLD adjusted close strictly above its trailing200-observation simple mean. Equality is risk-off. All200real observations are required.
methodology.joint_guard: When the joint index passes, retain the current monthly baseline target; otherwise put the entire98%invested budget in actual BIL.
methodology.component_guard: Independently disable equity or gold when its corresponding index fails. Move only that sleeve's original weight into actual BIL; do not increase the surviving sleeve or impose the baseline's equity minimum in a risk-off state.
methodology.requests: Issue the first fully informed target, subsequent gate-state changes, and completed month-end baseline updates. Other sessions remain no-order rows. Under extra execution delay all sequential dated requests retain their own later execution sessions; no pending request is overwritten.
methodology.execution: No same-close fill. Preserve next-session open5bpbase and one-extra-session20bpstress,USD10,000fresh accounts,USD1order charges, formal10y/5ywindows and all recurring Sharpe/SPY/15%drawdown gates.
methodology.interpretation: Daily200-session gates are an explicit adaptation of long-term moving-average timing, not a replication of the paper's monthly10-month rule. This is risk management on four existing families, not a new independent alpha factor or guaranteed drawdown ceiling.
methodology.selection: Motivated after102completed configurations on exposed overlapping history. Only these two fixed alternatives; no lookback/grid/share optimization, relabelled holdout or live promotion.
